title: 第十三章 华雄夜袭（下）

content_zh:
“盟主，董贼骑兵势不可挡，当以骑兵破之。”曹操上前道。
“嗯，孟德之言有理，传令骑兵冲锋！”袁绍和曹操手下的骑兵加起来大概有上千人，冲锋起来倒也颇有声势。
华雄露出一丝冷笑，这些骑兵在他眼中与骑在战马上的步兵无异，有些骑兵甚至不停的盯着地面，似乎害怕从战马上掉下来。
“杀！让这些反贼看看什么是骑兵。”华雄冷喝道。
仅仅一个冲锋过后，袁绍的脸色变得十分难看，己方的骑兵已经七零八落，正在被屠戮，而董卓麾下反倒越战越勇，已经靠近中军。
越来越多的诸侯汇聚到袁绍的周围，大军前方，在诸侯的严令下，士卒用躯体挡住了骑兵的冲击。
“杀！”掩杀而至的李傕部士卒士气如虹，冲上前去，华雄则是带领骑兵从侧翼发动进攻，似乎想要一举将诸侯击破。
“吕布到哪了？为何到现在还没消息？”袁绍气急败坏，早在骑兵被冲散的时候，他就派人通知吕布火速救援。
吕布带领两千骑兵，一路上不急不缓的走着，败退的联军士卒见到骑兵，如同见到魔鬼一般，纷纷让路。
“将军，华雄正带领兵马攻打中军，形势岌岌可危，请将军速往救援。”
吕布嘴角露出一丝笑意“告诉盟主，本将军正在与董贼士卒交战，稍后便至。”
曹性上前道：“将军，这已经是第四个了，看来盟主那是真的不行了。”那神情，哪有一丝焦急的模样，反倒给人以幸灾乐祸的感觉。
“传令，加速前进。”吕布不想因为自己导致诸侯大败，到时董卓就成为了最大的权臣，对谁都不利。
“报，吕布带领骑兵赶来，稍后便至。”华雄闻言眼神一紧，他最怕的莫过于并州的骑兵，那些骑兵的战斗力他可是深有体会，于是早早的命人在四周观察，一旦并州骑兵出现立刻通报。
“给这些人来点狠的。”华雄带领数百骑兵，直接冲进联军的阵营之中，远远看去，如同一把利剑，将联军阵型割开。
“撤！”见吕布带兵前来，且诸侯已经稳住了阵营，华雄一声大喝，亲自带领骑兵断后。
吕布只是远远的看了华雄一眼，策马向中军而去。
见吕布没来追赶，华雄长舒了一口气，诸侯中他最不愿面对的是吕布，西凉骑兵最不愿面对的是并州骑兵，那一夜汜水关外，并州骑兵的神威在西凉军中广为流传。
与此同时，公孙瓒带领一千白马义从一路杀来，这些骑兵皆是骑白马。
吕布向公孙瓒点了点头，整理一下铠甲，走向袁绍。

董卓军撤退了，诸侯大营仍旧一片慌乱，各路诸侯收拢兵马清点损失。
中军大帐，袁绍铁青着脸，手下五百名骑兵损失了一半，其他诸侯更是不如，许多士兵不是死在敌军手中，反而是死在自家人手中，其中尤以山阳太守袁遗和冀州刺史韩馥的损失最大，士兵死伤过半。
“吕将军，为何迟迟不来救援？”沉默良久之后，袁绍冷哼道。
其余诸侯纷纷将目光投向了吕布。
吕布拱手道：“盟主，昨夜董贼兵马来袭，并州军营寨亦是受到了冲击，本将得到盟主命令，亲自带领兵马救援，不想沿途皆是逃窜的盟军士卒，收拢兵马耽误了些许时间。”
公孙瓒出列道：“盟主，吕将军所言不虚，沿途皆是联军士卒。”
“哼，听说吕将军手下无一死伤？”袁术阴阳怪气的说道。
其余诸侯闻言心中一惊，在这种偷袭之下，诸侯或多或少有些损失，没想到并州军竟然无一死伤，莫非并州军知道华雄会偷袭。
公孙瓒看向吕布的目光包含了一丝忌惮，白马义从威名赫赫，在如此形势下损失了十几骑，没想到并州军竟然无一损伤。
与你有仇的人才是最了解你的果然适用于任何时候，吕布神情肃然道：“并州士卒皆是枕戈待旦。”
“枕戈待旦”这个词语对于领兵的将军来说并不陌生，在很多时候将领也是这样要求麾下士卒的，可是真正实施起来却不是那么回事，谁会没事穿着铠甲睡觉。
袁术出列道：“盟主，昨晚董贼袭营，我军士气大跌，当以精锐兵马在关外搦战，以挫董贼士气。”
吕布看向袁术的眼神有些诧异，没想到一向被自己看不起的袁术还有这等见识。

content_en:
"Alliance leader, Dong's cavalry is unstoppable, we should break it with cavalry." Cao Cao stepped forward and said.
"Well, what Meng De said makes sense, let's order the cavalry to charge!" The cavalry under Yuan Shao and Cao Cao totaled about a thousand people, and the charge was quite impressive.
Hua Xiong showed a sneer. In his eyes, these cavalrymen were no different from infantrymen on war horses. Some of the cavalrymen even kept staring at the ground, as if they were afraid of falling off their warhorses.
"Kill! Let these rebels see what cavalry is." Hua Xiong shouted coldly.
After just one charge, Yuan Shao's face became very ugly. His own cavalry was in shambles and was being slaughtered. However, Dong Zhuo's men became more and more courageous as they fought and were already close to the central army.
More and more princes gathered around Yuan Shao. In front of the army, under the strict orders of the princes, the soldiers blocked the impact of the cavalry with their bodies.
"Kill!" The soldiers of Li Jue's tribe who were covering up the attack were full of morale and rushed forward. Hua Xiong led the cavalry to attack from the flanks, seeming to want to defeat the princes in one fell swoop.
"Where is Lu Bu? Why is there no news yet?" Yuan Shao was furious. As early as when the cavalry was scattered, he sent someone to notify Lu Bu to rescue him immediately.
Lu Bu led two thousand cavalry and walked leisurely along the way. When the retreating coalition soldiers saw the cavalry, they gave way one after another as if they saw the devil.
"General, Hua Xiong is leading his troops to attack the Chinese army. The situation is in danger. General, please rush to rescue."
A smile appeared on Lu Bu's lips, "Tell the leader that this general is fighting Dong's soldiers and will be here later."
Cao Xing stepped forward and said: "General, this is already the fourth one. It seems that the alliance leader is really in trouble." There was no trace of anxiety in his expression, but instead gave people a feeling of gloating.
"Send the order, speed up." Lu Bu didn't want to cause the princes to be defeated because of himself. By then, Dong Zhuo would become the most powerful minister, which would be detrimental to everyone.
"Report, Lu Bu is coming with the cavalry and will be here soon." Hua Xiong's eyes tightened when he heard this. What he feared most was the Bingzhou cavalry. He was well aware of the combat effectiveness of those cavalry, so he ordered people to observe the surroundings early and report immediately as soon as the Bingzhou cavalry appeared.
"Be tough on these people." Hua Xiong led hundreds of cavalry and rushed directly into the coalition camp. From a distance, it looked like a sharp sword, cutting open the coalition formation.
"Retreat!" Seeing that Lu Bu was coming with his troops and that the princes had stabilized their camp, Hua Xiong shouted and personally led the cavalry to cut off the rear.
Lu Bu just glanced at Hua Xiong from a distance and rode towards the central army.
Seeing that Lu Bu did not come to chase, Hua Xiong breathed a sigh of relief. Among the princes, the one he did not want to face the most was Lu Bu. The one the Xiliang cavalry did not want to face the most was the Bingzhou cavalry. That night outside Sishui Pass, the power of the Bingzhou cavalry was widely spread among the Xiliang army.
At the same time, Gongsun Zan led a thousand white horse righteous soldiers to fight all the way. These cavalry were all riding white horses.
Lu Bu nodded to Gongsun Zan, adjusted his armor, and walked towards Yuan Shao.
Dong Zhuo's army retreated, but the princes' camp was still in panic. The princes gathered their troops and counted their losses.
At the main camp of the Chinese army, Yuan Shao was livid. He had lost half of his 500 cavalry. The other princes were even worse. Many soldiers died not in the hands of the enemy, but in the hands of their own family members. Among them, Yuan Yi, the governor of Shanyang, and Han Fu, the governor of Jizhou, suffered the greatest losses. More than half of their soldiers were killed or injured.
"General Lu, why haven't you come to rescue for so long?" Yuan Shao snorted coldly after a long silence.
The other princes turned their attention to Lu Bu.
Lu Bu cupped his hands and said, "Alliance leader, the Dong bandits' troops attacked last night, and the Bingzhou military camp was also attacked. I got the order from the alliance leader and personally led the troops to rescue. I didn't want all the fleeing Allied soldiers along the way, so it took some time to gather the troops and horses."
Gongsun Zan came out and said: "Alliance leader, what General Lu said is true. There are allied soldiers along the way."
"Hmph, I heard that General Lu has no one under his command.Casualties? "Yuan Shu said angrily.
The other princes were shocked when they heard this. Under this kind of sneak attack, the princes suffered more or less losses. Unexpectedly, no one in the Bingzhou Army was killed or injured. Could it be that the Bingzhou Army knew that Hua Xiong would attack in a sneak attack.
Gongsun Zan looked at Lu Bu with a hint of fear in his eyes. Baima Yicong was famous for his reputation. In such a situation, he lost more than a dozen horses. Unexpectedly, no one of the Bingzhou army was hurt.
Those who have enmity with you know you best. Sure enough, this applies to you at any time. Lu Bu said with a solemn expression: "The soldiers of Bingzhou are all on guard. "
The term "stand ready" is not unfamiliar to generals who lead troops. In many cases, generals also ask their soldiers to do this, but in actual implementation, it is not the case. Who would sleep wearing armor without any problem.
Yuan Shu came out and said: "Alliance leader, the Dong thieves attacked the camp last night, and the morale of our army dropped sharply. We should use our elite troops and horses to fight outside the pass to dampen the morale of the Dong thieves. "
Lu Bu looked at Yuan Shu in surprise. He didn't expect that Yuan Shu, whom he had always looked down upon, had such insight.
